status: DRAFT - based on published rehab-labelling practice; must be reviewed by a physiotherapist before labels are used to train anything

labels.name: Good
labels.description: Repetition reaches roughly 90% or more of the target range of motion, is smooth and controlled, and shows no compensation.

labels.name: Compensating
labels.description: The repetition may reach the target, but the patient uses other body parts to get there (see compensation tags). Wins over 'incomplete' when both apply.

labels.name: Incomplete
labels.description: Form is acceptable but the target range is not reached, or the repetition stops part-way.

labels.name: Unusable
labels.description: Not a valid attempt for training: tracking lost, patient out of frame, or not a real repetition. Excluded from export.

tags.name: Trunk forward / lean
tags.description: Upper body leans forward to help the movement.

tags.name: Trunk rotation
tags.description: Torso twists to help the movement.

tags.name: Shoulder elevation
tags.description: Shoulder is hiked up towards the ear.

tags.name: Other
tags.description: Any other compensation (e.g. trunk tilt or backward lean); explain in the note.
